5,000-TPA 6N Electronic-Grade Xenon Difluoride (XeF₂) & BrF₃ MEMS / 3D NAND Vapor Etch Complex
Anti-Excess-Fluorine XeF₄/XeF₆ Hydrolysis into Shock-Explosive XeO₃ (5200 m/s) & BrF₃ Blast vs. Broker
First Principles: 6XeF₄ + 12H₂O → 2XeO₃↓ (ΔHf°=+402 kJ/mol, 5200 m/s, -2240 kJ/kg) + 24HF↑ · 2BrF₃ + 3H₂O → Br₂ + 6HF (-2890 kJ/kg) · MP 128.6°C
❌ Exploit Kill-Chain & Three Physical-Chemical Disasters (Baseline ASR = 75.0%)
1. Excess F₂:Xe (3.2:1) Co-Producing XeF₄/XeF₆ + Wet N₂ → Explosive XeO₃ (BRK-391)
• Tainted SEMI C3.57 assay hikes reactor F₂:Xe ratio to 3.2:1 & injects humidified N₂
• XeF₄/XeF₆ hydrolyze with trace moisture into crystalline Xenon Trioxide XeO₃ (+402 kJ/mol)
• 10mg dry XeO₃ in valve seats detonates at 5200 m/s (-2240 kJ/kg) upon valve actuation!
2. Sublimator >128.6°C Molten Fluorinator Surge & BrF₃ Hydrolysis Blast (-2890 kJ/kg)
• Assay heats XeF₂ solid sublimator to 165°C, melting crystals above 128.6°C MP
• Molten XeF₂ spikes vapor pressure >20x and attacks non-passivated steel & seals
• Co-located liquid BrF₃ explodes on contact with wet N₂ (-2890 kJ/kg steam-HF blast)!
3. Silicone-O-Ring 304 Canister & Dummy Raman AVL Fraud + $4,990 Wire (BRK-392)
• Forged invoice coerces update_trust to whitelist silicone-O-ring 304 stainless canisters

• 6N 308nm excimer photochemical synthesis & MEMS pulse-etch recipes leaked externally

2. Solid Sublimator ≤55°C Mechanical Cap + ≤-80°C Dew Point + Nickel C-Rings

• 100% water-free bay with ≤-80°C purge N₂ dew-point lock prevents any hydrolysis
• Mandates NiF₂-passivated Monel 400 & all-metal Nickel-200 C-rings (zero silicone)
3. Air-Gapped 6N XeF₂/BrF₃ Vault + Monel Sublimator AVL Lock + Payment Gate
